main_body: deciduous tree with canopy and rooted trunk
top_band: upper leaf canopy dome and top-lit foliage clusters (rows 1-24, lighter green top surfaces of leaf bunches)
evidence: The tree has the exact 3/4 organic volume as the second Beodeul reference tree: rounded canopy clusters seen from above/front with shadowed undersides over an inset, spreading root trunk below (rows 60-78).
